ONNX Runtime 1.31.1 public C/C++ API headers, unmodified from Microsoft's official CPU SDK.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/v1.31.1

The headers and runtime retain the MIT license and third-party notices in
`distribution/licenses/onnxruntime`. Runtime binaries are fetched separately with
`scripts/fetch-stems-assets.py` and checksum-verified; they are not stored in Git.
